title: 7 Best AI Coding Agents in 2026: Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Cline, and More Compared
summary: We tested and ranked 7 agentic coding tools in 2026 — with real screenshots, live pricing, and honest tradeoffs. Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Cline, Aider, Codex, Copilot compared.
body_markdown: For most professional developers, Cursor is the easier starting point — you keep your VS Code environment and get immediate Tab completions. For complex, reasoning-heavy tasks across large codebases, Claude Code produces better output. Many developers use both: Cursor for daily development and Claude Code for specific hard problems. Both integrate with Blink for full-stack deployment.
